source: 2015 Illinois 5K original Strava GPX activity 641965799, reviewed against 2016 comparison

routes.geometryNote: Original 2015 Strava GPS preserves the final 1.82 km (162 points). The opening ~3.18 km was not recorded and is intentionally not drawn; the 2016 course is not an accurate substitute because its direction differs at the observed 2015 segment. 2015 course map unavailable. Route is incomplete, not a full 5K reconstruction.

reconstructionEvidence.officialHistoricalSourceFinding: 2015 University of Illinois Athletics article confirms Friday 5K at 7:30 pm and Kirby Avenue road closure; it links a race-year 5K map but map coordinates are not yet retrieved.
reconstructionEvidence.caution: 2016 GPS route overlaps the 2015 observed corridor, but simple 2016-prefix plus 2015-observed track falls roughly 0.53 km short. Do not publish as complete 2015 course or fabricate a loop. Preserve 2015 source geometry and official 2015 chip time 23:27.
reconstructionEvidence.historical2015CourseMapAvailability: Original map link currently inaccessible; archive recovery required before claiming exact 2015 geometry.
reconstructionEvidence.reference2016Interpretation: Observed 2015 points overlap the 2016 course closely, but the 2016-prefix splice is 4.467 km, 0.533 km shorter than a nominal 5K; reference 2016 geometry is corroboration only, not a replacement.

directionalMismatchAtSplice.finding: The 2016 course travels eastbound at the closest splice point while the 2015 GPS travels westbound; the two routes overlap spatially but run opposite directions here. A naive 2016-prefix plus 2015-suffix would reverse direction and undercount by ~0.53 km.
directionalMismatchAtSplice.implication: Do not treat the 2016 prefix as the 2015 route. Need original 2015 map or independently verified course; the 2016 recording is only spatial corroboration.
